product_metadata.title: ULG Soap Dispensers Bottles 16oz Countertop Lotion Clear with Stainless Steel Pump Empty BPA Free Liquid Hand Soap Dispenser Boston Round Plastic Press Bottle 2 Piece
features: SAFETY MATERIAL - Each dispenser is made of food-grade PET plastic and stainless steel, which are BPA and lead free, safe for your family.(Please note that 304 stainless steel pump head will rust when exposed to strong acid or alkali liquids.)

STURDY & DURABLE - Stainless steel pump is anti-corrosive and rustproof, The pump head can be pressed more than 10,000 times after pressing test, PET plastic is resistant to falling and not easy to break.
NO LEAKING & NO DRIPPING - Our pump heads contain leak-proof gaskets to prevent liquid leaks and the stainless steel tips ensure that there is no wasted dripping when dispensing liquids.
REUSABLE & VERSATILE - Reusable and refillable, eco-friendly green, money saving,great for liquid soap, dish soap, lotion, mouthwash, essential oils, massage oils and much more.
CONVENIENCE - Designed with 2CC pump core and the nozzle is large enough to dispense needed amount of liquid without extra effort required and 16oz large capacity for the whole family.
